audit.scope: Read-only development official TLS file/hash/license audit, no root CAS/current receipt/native installation/target acceptance. Existing observe_python_wheel_license gives observation, not eligibility. PyPI JSON info may differ from wheel metadata; wheel bytes and embedded notices are authoritative evidence.

license_policy_source.custody: Exact finite reviewed source artifact member in verified installed release; resolver rereads nofollow held-release FD and descriptor role/path/hash/size/current release/actor. No module import proof or caller policy mapping. Add only this fixed source-role mapping; existing source role semantics unchanged.

license_issuer.rule: Exact retained issuer membership and current selection/lock/CAS/release policy. Match one exact policy row by normalized name+version+wheel SHA+filename+size; inspect actual bounded verified wheel zip without executing. Compare exact METADATA hash, declarations and all reviewed embedded license/notice hashes/size/path; reject duplicate/unsafe members/aliases/conflicting declarations/missing license files. Existing observer can share bounded parser, but exact policy verifier must also cover legacy license files/NOTICE/AUTHORS not listed by License-File. No caller eligibility string, broad SPDX allowlist or metadata-only authorization. Unknown wheels or changed evidence deny. Receipt eligibility literal eligible-with-retained-notices only after actual match.
license_issuer.digest: license_evidence_sha256=SHA256 canonical UTF8 JSON sorted compact ensure_ascii=False allow_nan=False of {wheel_sha256,wheel_metadata_sha256,license_files:[path-sorted {path,sha256,size_bytes}],policy_sha256,eligibility,obligations_sha256}. closure license digest commits filename-sorted wheel eligibility receipt digest rows, not receipt strings alone.
license_issuer.lifetime: Original min current selection/session/controller/lock/PM/CAS lifetime; historical policy source remains evidence, not renewed effect authority. Materializer preserves notices and validates their resulting package membership.

acquisition.transport: No subprocess/pip/resolver/worker network, no generic URL fetch capability. Private root-owned default TLS HTTPS opener with ProxyHandler({}) and NoRedirect. Existing exact current Gateway acquisition choice/permission and controller original deadline authorize only this finite metadata+file exchange. No secret/header/token supplied; fixed Accept/User-Agent/identity encoding. Ambient proxy/config/CA override ignored; platform verified trust store, hostname validation and certificate verification remain enabled.
acquisition.metadata: GET https://pypi.org/pypi/<PEP503-normalized exact lock name>/<exact lock version>/json only. Name/version must match bounded lock grammar; URL components percent-encoded, forbid slash/query/fragment/userinfo/port. HTTP200 application/json only, identity encoding, max2MiB raw body, bounded headers, reject duplicate JSON keys/nonfinite values. Select exactly one bdist_wheel URL whose SHA256 belongs to exact lock row and name/version/filename/CPython3.14 Linux ARM64 or compatible abi3/pure tags match; no latest endpoint/sdist/transitive dependencies/yanked file.
acquisition.wheel: Only selected metadata URL with scheme https, exact hostname files.pythonhosted.org, port absent/443, no userinfo/query/fragment, canonical /packages/ safe path and basename exact selected filename; redirects disabled even to same host. Bind exact metadata advertised hash/size, Content-Length when present, identity encoding, HTTP200 application/octet-stream or binary/octet-stream. Bounded streamed read into current root-owned CAS temporary object; no HTML/error body acceptance. SHA/actual size must equal lock+metadata. No arbitrary caller URL/address/header.
acquisition.network: Use existing reviewed DNS/address validation to deny private/loopback/link-local/reserved answers and pin connection to selected validated public address while preserving exact TLS SNI/hostname; deny DNS rebinding and changes mid-request. Custodian retains original choice/controller/selection at each request/read. This is a root-only finite transport method, not a worker egress grant or reusable network lease. Managed build remains offline; no network namespace opened to pip.
acquisition.bounds: At most13 metadata plus13 exact file requests for current lock, each30s connect/read slices, whole900s or original deadline whichever sooner; cancellation/currentness checked between reads. Existing max64/512MiB per wheel/1GiB total unchanged; exact selected13 and measured7,573,114-byte current closure still required. max bounded error/log summaries4096 bytes with no remote body. No retries outside original bounded call; explicit root resume reacquires current proofs.
acquisition.failure: TLS/host/redirect/metadata/hash/license/cancel/deadline failure leaves no member receipt or build admission. Close tracked sockets/FDs and remove only owned temporary entries; immutable verified CAS may remain. No raw body return to worker, no target networking or provider budget.

integration: Gateway registry first retains immutable CAS readback then obtains exact license eligibility receipts before minting dependency/member closure. Source/PM projection and lock remain distinct proofs. A verified download may exist without eligible build receipt; after all13 current wheel eligibility proofs, issue v244 closure with license_evidence_sha256 and root-held FD members. v239 store consumes same genuine issuer source projection. No fabricated future active generation, global license policy change or wider consent.
